SELECT LOT_ID,OPE_NO,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,LOT_TYPE ,SUB_LOT_TYPE,PRODG1,TECH,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO,MODULE,START_TIME,ADD_DUR,HOLD_TIME,CLIP_STATUS ,COMMIT_DATE,SCRAP_FLAG,SCRAP_COMMENT,OUTPUT_FLAG,NRELEASE ,CASE WHEN SCRAP_FLAG = '0' THEN'不出货' WHEN SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND OUTPUT_FLAG ='Y' THEN '本月出货' WHEN SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND OUTPUT_FLAG ='N' THEN '本月不出货' END COMMENT1 FROM( SELECT A.LOT_ID, A.OPE_NO, A.WAFER_QTY, A.PRODSPEC_ID, A.LOT_PROC_STATE, A.LOT_TYPE , A.SUB_LOT_TYPE, A.PRODG1, A.TECH, A.HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO, NVL(B.MODULE,A.MODULE)MODULE ,TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') START_TIME , A.ADD_DUR, A.HOLD_TIME, A.CLIP_STATUS, A.COMMIT_DATE ,NVL(B.SCRAP_FLAG,A.SCRAP_FLAG)SCRAP_FLAG,NVL(B.SCRAP_COMMENT,A.SCRAP_COMMENT)SCRAP_COMMENT ,CASE WHEN B.SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND SUBSTR(REPLACE(B.SCRAP_COMMENT,'/',''),1,6) <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4/24,'YYYYMM') THEN 'Y' WHEN NVL(B.SCRAP_FLAG,A.SCRAP_FLAG) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'N' END OUTPUT_FLAG ,CASE WHEN B.SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND TO_DATE(B.SCRAP_COMMENT,'YYYY/MM/DD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE-4/24) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END NRELEASE FROM A1MFG.WAT_HOLD_LOT_DETAILS A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT KEY1 LOT_ID,KEY2 SCRAP_FLAG,KEY3 SCRAP_COMMENT,KEY4 HOLD_START_DATE,KEY5 MODULE FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'WAT_HOLD_LOT_COMMENT' )B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') = B.HOLD_START_DATE )WHERE 1=1
AND DECODE(NVL(MODULE,'OTHERS'),'MFG','MFG(INT需求)',NVL(MODULE,'OTHERS')) = #{module}
AND SCRAP_COMMENT = '待提报废单'
AND SCRAP_COMMENT = '报废单已提'
AND NVL(OUTPUT_FLAG,'Y') = 'N' AND SCRAP_FLAG = 1
AND NVL(OUTPUT_FLAG,'N') = 'Y' AND SCRAP_FLAG = 1
AND NRELEASE = 'Y'
AND SCRAP_FLAG IS NULL
AND (SCRAP_FLAG IS NULL OR (NVL(OUTPUT_FLAG,'N') = 'Y' AND SCRAP_FLAG = 1))
AND ADD_DUR < 24
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY A USING( SELECT 'WAT_HOLD_LOT_COMMENT' FUNCTION_NAME , #{param.lotId} LOT_ID,#{param.scrapFlag} SCRAP_FLAG ,#{param.scrapComment} SCRAP_COMMENT ,#{param.holdLotStartTime} HOLD_START_TIME ,#{param.module} MODULE ,SYSDATE UPDATE_TIME ,#{param.updateUser} UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL ) B ON(A.KEY1=B.LOT_ID AND A.KEY4=B.HOLD_START_TIME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.KEY2=B.SCRAP_FLAG,A.KEY3=B.SCRAP_COMMENT,A.UPDATE_TIME=B.UPDATE_TIME,A.UPDATE_USER=B.UPDATE_USER
,A.KEY5 = B.MODULE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FUNCTION_NAME,KEY1, KEY2, KEY3,KEY4,KEY5,UPDATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER)VALUES(B.FUNCTION_NAME,B.LOT_ID,B.SCRAP_FLAG,B.SCRAP_COMMENT,B.HOLD_START_TIME,B.MODULE,B.UPDATE_TIME,B.UPDATE_USER)
mapper.select: WITH DETAILS_INFO AS ( SELECT A.LOT_ID, A.OPE_NO, A.WAFER_QTY, A.PRODSPEC_ID, A.LOT_PROC_STATE, A.LOT_TYPE , A.SUB_LOT_TYPE, A.PRODG1, A.TECH, A.HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO, NVL(B.MODULE,A.MODULE)MODULE ,TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') START_TIME , A.ADD_DUR, A.HOLD_TIME, A.CLIP_STATUS, A.COMMIT_DATE ,NVL(B.SCRAP_FLAG,A.SCRAP_FLAG)SCRAP_FLAG,NVL(B.SCRAP_COMMENT,A.SCRAP_COMMENT)SCRAP_COMMENT ,CASE WHEN B.SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND SUBSTR(REPLACE(B.SCRAP_COMMENT,'/',''),1,6) <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4/24,'YYYYMM') THEN 'Y' WHEN NVL(B.SCRAP_FLAG,A.SCRAP_FLAG) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'N' END OUTPUT_FLAG FROM A1MFG.WAT_HOLD_LOT_DETAILS A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT KEY1 LOT_ID,KEY2 SCRAP_FLAG,KEY3 SCRAP_COMMENT,KEY4 HOLD_START_DATE,KEY5 MODULE FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'WAT_HOLD_LOT_COMMENT' )B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') = B.HOLD_START_DATE ),TRANSFER_INFO AS( SELECT A.LOT_ID,A.WAFER_QTY,A.HOLD_TIME,A.ADD_DUR,DECODE(NVL(A.MODULE,'OTHERS'),'MFG','MFG(INT需求)',NVL(A.MODULE,'OTHERS'))MODULE,A.SCRAP_COMMENT ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_COMMENT ='待提报废单' THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END WAIT_SCRAP_WIP ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_COMMENT = '报废单已提' THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END SCRAPED_WIP ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND TO_DATE(SCRAP_COMMENT,'YYYY/MM/DD') >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-4/24,'MM'),1) THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END NEXT_MONTH_WIP ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND TO_DATE(SCRAP_COMMENT,'YYYY/MM/DD') < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-4/24,'MM'),1) THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END CUR_MONTH_WIP ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND TO_DATE(SCRAP_COMMENT,'YYYY/MM/DD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE-4/24) THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END NON_RELEASE_WIP ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_FLAG IS NULL THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END WAIT_BACK_WIP ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_FLAG IS NULL THEN HOLD_TIME END WAIT_HOLD_TIME ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND TO_DATE(SCRAP_COMMENT,'YYYY/MM/DD') < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-4/24,'MM'),1) THEN HOLD_TIME END CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME ,CASE WHEN ADD_DUR < 24 THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END ADD_QTY FROM DETAILS_INFO A ),SUMMARY_WIP_DTH AS( SELECT MODULE,SUM(WAIT_SCRAP_WIP)WAIT_SCRAP_WIP,SUM(SCRAPED_WIP)SCRAPED_WIP ,SUM(NEXT_MONTH_WIP)NEXT_MONTH_WIP,SUM(CUR_MONTH_WIP)CUR_MONTH_WIP ,SUM(NON_RELEASE_WIP)NON_RELEASE_WIP ,SUM(WAIT_BACK_WIP)WAIT_BACK_WIP ,ROUND(NVL(AVG(WAIT_HOLD_TIME),0),1) WAIT_HOLD_TIME ,SUM(WAIT_BACK_WIP+CUR_MONTH_WIP)TOTAL_WIP ,ROUND(NVL(AVG(CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME),0),1)CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME ,SUM(ADD_QTY)ADD_QTY FROM TRANSFER_INFO GROUP BY MODULE ), YD_WIP_SUMMARY AS( SELECT MODULE,SUM(CUR_MONTH_QTY+WAIT_BACK_WIP)YD_WIP FROM( SELECT DECODE(NVL(A.MODULE,'OTHERS'),'MFG','MFG(INT需求)',NVL(A.MODULE,'OTHERS'))MODULE ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_FLAG = '1' AND TO_DATE(SCRAP_COMMENT,'YYYY/MM/DD') < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-4/24,'MM'),1) THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END CUR_MONTH_QTY ,CASE WHEN A.SCRAP_FLAG IS NULL THEN A.WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END WAIT_BACK_WIP FROM A1MFG.WAT_HOLD_LOT_HISTORY A WHERE SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1,'YYYYMMDD') )GROUP BY MODULE ),PAGE_SHOW_DETAILS_INFO AS( SELECT A.*,NVL(B.YD_WIP,0)YD_WIP FROM SUMMARY_WIP_DTH A LEFT JOIN YD_WIP_SUMMARY B ON A.MODULE = B.MODULE ),SUMMARY_DETAILS_1 AS( SELECT 'TOTAL' MODULE,SUM(WAIT_SCRAP_WIP)WAIT_SCRAP_WIP ,SUM(SCRAPED_WIP)SCRAPED_WIP,SUM(NEXT_MONTH_WIP)NEXT_MONTH_WIP ,SUM(CUR_MONTH_WIP)CUR_MONTH_WIP,SUM(NON_RELEASE_WIP)NON_RELEASE_WIP ,SUM(WAIT_BACK_WIP)WAIT_BACK_WIP,ROUND(NVL(AVG(WAIT_HOLD_TIME),0),1)WAIT_HOLD_TIME ,SUM(YD_WIP)YD_WIP,SUM(TOTAL_WIP)TOTAL_WIP ,ROUND(NVL(AVG(CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME),0),1)CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME ,SUM(ADD_QTY)ADD_QTY FROM PAGE_SHOW_DETAILS_INFO ),SUMMARY_DETAILS_2 AS( SELECT 'TOTAL' MODULE,SUM(WAIT_SCRAP_WIP+SCRAPED_WIP+NEXT_MONTH_WIP)WAIT_SCRAP_WIP ,SUM(WAIT_SCRAP_WIP+SCRAPED_WIP+NEXT_MONTH_WIP)SCRAPED_WIP ,SUM(WAIT_SCRAP_WIP+SCRAPED_WIP+NEXT_MONTH_WIP)NEXT_MONTH_WIP ,SUM(CUR_MONTH_WIP)CUR_MONTH_WIP,SUM(NON_RELEASE_WIP)NON_RELEASE_WIP ,SUM(WAIT_BACK_WIP)WAIT_BACK_WIP,ROUND(NVL(AVG(WAIT_HOLD_TIME),0),1)WAIT_HOLD_TIME ,SUM(YD_WIP)YD_WIP,SUM(TOTAL_WIP)TOTAL_WIP ,ROUND(NVL(AVG(CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME ),1),1)CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME ,SUM(ADD_QTY)ADD_QTY FROM PAGE_SHOW_DETAILS_INFO ),PAGE_SUMMARY_INFO AS( SELECT MODULE,WAIT_SCRAP_WIP,SCRAPED_WIP ,NEXT_MONTH_WIP,CUR_MONTH_WIP,NON_RELEASE_WIP,WAIT_BACK_WIP ,WAIT_HOLD_TIME,TOTAL_WIP,CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME,ADD_QTY,YD_WIP FROM PAGE_SHOW_DETAILS_INFO UNION ALL SELECT MODULE,WAIT_SCRAP_WIP,SCRAPED_WIP ,NEXT_MONTH_WIP,CUR_MONTH_WIP,NON_RELEASE_WIP,WAIT_BACK_WIP ,WAIT_HOLD_TIME,TOTAL_WIP,CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME,ADD_QTY,YD_WIP FROM SUMMARY_DETAILS_1 UNION ALL SELECT MODULE,WAIT_SCRAP_WIP,SCRAPED_WIP ,NEXT_MONTH_WIP,CUR_MONTH_WIP,NON_RELEASE_WIP,WAIT_BACK_WIP ,WAIT_HOLD_TIME,TOTAL_WIP,CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME,ADD_QTY,YD_WIP FROM SUMMARY_DETAILS_2 ) SELECT MODULE,WAIT_SCRAP_WIP,SCRAPED_WIP,NEXT_MONTH_WIP ,CUR_MONTH_WIP,NON_RELEASE_WIP,WAIT_BACK_WIP ,WAIT_HOLD_TIME,TOTAL_WIP,CUR_MONTH_HOLD_TIME,ADD_QTY,YD_WIP FROM PAGE_SUMMARY_INFO ORDER BY DECODE(MODULE,'TOTAL',2,1),TOTAL_WIP DESC,SCRAPED_WIP DESC,WAIT_HOLD_TIME DESC

WITH CHART_DATA AS( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,DECODE(NVL(MODULE,'OTHERS'),'MFG','MFG(INT需求)',NVL(MODULE,'OTHERS'))MODULE,LOT_ID,WAFER_QTY,SCRAP_FLAG,SCRAP_COMMENT ,CASE WHEN SCRAP_FLAG = 0 THEN 0 WHEN SCRAP_FLAG = 1 AND TO_DATE(SCRAP_COMMENT,'YYYY/MM/DD') < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-4/24,'MM'),1) THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE WAFER_QTY END CUR_MONTH_WIP FROM A1MFG.WAT_HOLD_LOT_HISTORY WHERE SHIFT_DATE > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-4/24 -4,'YYYYMMDD') ) SELECT MODULE,TD_WIP,YD_WIP,PRE2D_WIP,PRE3D_WIP FROM( SELECT MODULE,TD_WIP,YD_WIP,PRE2D_WIP,PRE3D_WIP ,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DECODE(MODULE,'OTHERS',0,TD_WIP) DESC)RN FROM( SELECT MODULE,MAX(TD_WIP)TD_WIP ,MAX(YD_WIP)YD_WIP ,MAX(PRE2D_WIP)PRE2D_WIP ,MAX(PRE3D_WIP)PRE3D_WIP FROM( SELECT MODULE ,CASE WHEN SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.4/24,'YYYYMMDD') THEN CUR_MONTH_WIP ELSE 0 END TD_WIP ,CASE WHEN SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.4/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') THEN CUR_MONTH_WIP ELSE 0 END YD_WIP ,CASE WHEN SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.4/24-2,'YYYYMMDD') THEN CUR_MONTH_WIP ELSE 0 END PRE2D_WIP ,CASE WHEN SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.4/24-3,'YYYYMMDD') THEN CUR_MONTH_WIP ELSE 0 END PRE3D_WIP FROM( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,MODULE,NVL(SUM(CUR_MONTH_WIP),0)CUR_MONTH_WIP FROM CHART_DATA GROUP BY MODULE,SHIFT_DATE ) )GROUP BY MODULE ))WHERE RN<=5
